title: Inspect what the Codespace actually provides
demonstrates: no tool is assumed by the MCP itself

steps.script:
for tool in git python3 node npm java go cargo docker; do
  if command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%-8s %s\n' "$tool" "$("$tool" --version 2>&1 | head -1)"; else printf '%-8s not installed\n' "$tool"; fi
done
